character: the same recurring cartoon protagonist in every image (identity never changes): a young man with a perfectly round smooth glossy white head, no ears, no hair, no nose, big simple glossy black oval eyes with a small white highlight, short thick expressive black eyebrows, small simple mouth, bare simple white four-finger cartoon hands (same white as the head, NO gloves) and thin black limbs; outfit: mustard-yellow ribbed knit beanie, oversized dark navy bomber jacket with burnt-orange inner lining at collar and cuffs, charcoal-grey t-shirt, loose black cargo pants, chunky red-and-white high-top sneakers; no logos or emblems on clothes

composition: main subject in the middle third, keep the bottom 25% of the frame visually calm for subtitles, keep the top 12% calm for an overlay bar; the background is always a fully detailed, recognizable environment from the story's place and period (furniture, walls, objects, people) — never an empty black, plain gradient or blank wall background TEXT RULE: text is allowed but ONLY real, correctly spelled, period-appropriate Turkish words that make sense in the scene (for example shop signs 'BAKKAL', 'KEBAP', 'MANAV', 'BERBER', 'LOKANTA', 'PASTANE', 'OTEL', a taxi sign 'TAKSİ', a realistic Turkish license plate like '34 TK 512'). Signs may also use simple pictures or icons instead of or next to words. NEVER gibberish, invented, misspelled or half-cut words; if unsure, use a picture or leave the sign plain.

cast: EVERY other person in the image (shopkeepers, crowds, family, children, elderly) is the SAME cartoon species as the main character, never a realistic human: perfectly round smooth glossy white head, no nose, no ears, big simple glossy black oval eyes, simple mouth, bare white four-finger cartoon hands, thin black limbs, same thick ink outlines. They differ ONLY by clothing and head accessories chosen for the story's period and their role. WOMEN are always clearly female: long dark eyelashes, a hairstyle (dark hair bun, ponytail or long hair) or a headscarf, and women's clothing (skirts, dresses, blouses, cardigans). MEN are always clearly male: no eyelashes, short dark hair, a flat cap or bare head, optionally a thick black mustache, and men's clothing (trousers, shirts, vests, jackets). Children are smaller versions with the same rules. Never mix male and female features on one character. No realistic human faces or skin anywhere, including photos and posters on walls. VARIETY: no two background characters may look alike — give each one a clearly different body type (thin, chubby, tall, short, broad), age cues (grey or white hair, white mustache, glasses, wrinkle lines, a cane for the elderly), facial hair style for men (none, thin, thick, handlebar mustache, short beard), headwear or hairstyle (flat cap, skullcap, fedora, bald, side-parted hair, curly hair; for women different headscarf colors/patterns, bun, short perm, long hair), clothing colors and patterns (checkered, striped, plain, knitted), accessories (prayer beads, cigarette, newspaper, tea glass, glasses) and individual expressions and poses, so every character is instantly distinguishable.
